NPU: Neural Processing Unit: the phone chip's AI accelerator (Hexagon on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3). It runs our model.
QIDK: Qualcomm Innovators Development Kit: a phone-class board with the Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 (SM8650). Our edge device.
SM8650: The Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 system-on-chip inside the QIDK.
htpd: Our batched NPU daemon: one long-lived process that keeps the model on the NPU and serves every request.
Genie: Qualcomm's GenAI runtime for running language models on the NPU.
GPTQ: A post-training quantisation method that rounds weights to 4 bits while correcting the error it introduces.
CI: 95% confidence interval: the range the true value lies in with 95% confidence, given the samples.
n: Number of samples behind a value.
Mode 1: Rules only: no AI, just the rule engine. The baseline.
Mode 2: Single AI: one AI call looks at all the problem sensors at once.
Mode 3: Multi-agent: one domain agent per problem sensor, then a synthesiser call combines them into one root cause.
latency: Time from a request to a finished answer.
prefix cache: Re-using the model state for the part of the prompt that never changes, so only the new part is processed.
fine-tune: Further training of a pretrained model on our own task examples.
policy gate: Safety check on every AI answer: correct format, only real evidence ids, no shut-down orders.
domain agent: An AI call that analyses one sensor type (air, water, power...) over its 4-hour window.
